name: Neural Volume Raycasting Debug Visualization
aliases: Debug Visualization Pipeline for Neural Volumes
definition: A debugging visualization pipeline that renders rays through a neural volume model, applies activation functions to raw outputs, and visualizes sample points as instanced spheres colored by predicted radiance and filtered by an opacity threshold.
summary: Neural Volume Raycasting Debug Visualization renders raw sample points as instanced spheres to inspect spatial distribution and model predictions, unlike standard compositing.
